receipts.scope: B preserve ordinary file permissions during atomic patch updates and moves
receipts.trigger: Commit 92bdd05 was created while the current installed apply_patch had removed the executable bit of .githooks/commit-msg. Git reported that the hook was ignored. That automatic hook check did not run; the same commit message was subsequently validated directly by the Rust checker.
receipts.before: Seven added tests yielded four failures; update/move discarded executable bits and widened a dummy 0600 file to 0664 under the test environment's umask.
receipts.after: Prepared changes carry source ordinary rwx bits. Staging starts with restricted source permissions before content write; updates/moves restore ordinary bits after umask. Special setuid/setgid/sticky bits are not inherited on changed content. New files retain default umask behavior.
receipts.boundaries: No owner/group/ACL/xattr preservation claim; no weaker path, authorization or transaction checks. Existing hard-link rollback restores original bytes and original mode.
